{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Sandwiches|Sandwiches]]

The '''b'''acon, '''l'''ettuce and '''t'''omato sandwich, commonly referred to as the '''BLT''', is a classic sandwich that can be found almost everywhere.

==Ingredients==
*[[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]], sliced into rashers
*[[Cookbook:Lettuce|Lettuce]], washed and shredded, torn, or in whole leaves
*Ripe [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] into thin disks
*2 slices of any type of [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
*Sandwich spread or condiments (e.g., [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]], [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]], [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]], or [[Cookbook:mustard|mustard]], although mayonnaise is traditional)
*Ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]], if desired

==Procedures==
#[[Cookbook:Toasting|Toast]] the 2 slices of bread.
#While the bread is toasting, [[Cookbook:Broiling|broil]] or [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the bacon until crisp, taking care not to burn it.
#Once the toasted bread is ready, spread with desired condiments.
#Layer one slice of toast with the lettuce, tomato slices, and bacon. Add black pepper as desired. Top with other slice of toast.
#Cut into triangles or halves as preferred. Serve immediately.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*The lettuce, if shredded, may be mixed with the mayonnaise before layering the toast.
*The lettuce may be omitted, or another green substituted. [[Cookbook:watercress|Watercress]] is a nice addition.
*You may add slivers of ripe [[Cookbook:avocado|avocado]] or raw or cooked red [[Cookbook:onion|onion]] to the sandwich, or may substitute them for the lettuce or tomato.
*You may top the hot bacon in the sandwich with a slice of [[Cookbook:cheese|cheese]], such as cheddar, American, muenster, or pepper jack, or use it to replace the tomato (a sandwich prepared in this way is called a BLC sandwich, for "bacon, lettuce, and cheese.")
*You may place a fried [[Cookbook:egg|egg]] in the sandwich. If the egg is fried over-easy or sunny-side-up, the egg's [[Cookbook:Egg yolk|yolk]] may be broken just before serving so that it dresses the contents of the sandwich. 
*The slices of bread do not need to be toasted, although toast adds a nice texture.
*You may spread the bread with [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]] for an interesting variation.
*You may top the sandwich or its contents with [[Cookbook:Hollandaise Sauce|hollandaise sauce]].
*Add [[Cookbook:ham|ham]], [[Cookbook:turkey|turkey]] and [[Cookbook:Swiss Cheese|Swiss cheese]] for a BLT club sandwich.
*For a [[Cookbook:vegan|vegan]] variation on the BLT, use marinated and fried or grilled strips of [[Cookbook:tempeh|tempeh]] to substitute for the bacon. Vegetable protein-based false bacon products are also available in some grocery freezers. Use mayonnaise, a vegan mayonnaise substitute, in place of the mayo.
*A BLT sandwich can also be served on a (non-toasted) hot dog bun or larger variation thereof (although in this case the bacon, lettuce, and tomato should all be shredded.)

==Warnings==

* Take care when frying the bacon to avoid a grease fire. Should one occur, '''do not''' douse the flames with water, as this will cause the fire to spread; instead, cover the pan tightly or heap with baking soda to smother the flames, and remove from the heat.
